_comment: Dobot Nova 2 mounted on robot_01's ONIX base. require_base_at_zone: the arm only runs a pick/place when the base reports (in its heartbeat) that it is at the task's location -- i.e. its last move there was verified and it has not moved since. travel_joints is required: the base will not drive until the arm reports it is in this pose. One DobotStudio Pro project per (action, location); each project ends in the travel pose and writes SetOutputInt(0, 1) on success / SetOutputInt(0, 2) on failure. Check the controller IP and firmware generation (v3/v4) in DobotStudio Pro before first use.

driver.travel_joints: REQUIRED: 6 joint angles of the tucked-in pose, read with tools/dobot_console.py GetAngle()
